title: Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Blue Razz Lemonade offers a dynamic blend of zesty lemonade and the rich tang of iconic blue raspberry. This e-liquid captures the perfect balance of citrus and berry slushy flavours, making it an ideal choice for those who seek a tangy and vibrant vape. This e-liquid is part of the Vampire Vape Bar Salts range and is presented in a generous 100ml shortfill bottle with a 60VG/40PG ratio. This mix ensures a satisfying balance of flavour intensity and vapour production, suited for mouth-to-lung devices and ideal for vapers who prefer a more immersive taste experience with moderate cloud output. Compatible with coils of 0.6ohm or higher, it is designed to deliver a smooth and enjoyable MTL vaping session. Each bottle provides ample space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise the nicotine strength up to 120ml of 3mg e-liquid if desired. This versatility makes it a preferred option for both nicotine and non-nicotine users seeking quality and customisation in their vaping journey. Explore the full range of flavours in the Vampire Vape Bar Salts Shortfill collection, which includes diverse and unique options tailored to meet the tastes of all vapers, ensuring everyone finds a flavour that’s right for them.
